signals.content: Nixpkgs overlay for AI agent skills from skills.sh and skillsdirectory.com
signals.score_reason: high-value open-source ecosystem signal; agentic AI relevance. Final score: 72. Freshness: source age 0d.
signals.brief_en:
Title: sudosubin/agents.nix
Source: Nixpkgs overlay that aggregates AI agent skill definitions from the public repositories skills.sh and skillsdirectory.com. The overlay provides a declarative, reproducible way to import, version‑pin, and configure these skill modules within Nix environments. It enables rapid deployment of standardized agent capabilities while preserving provenance and allowing selective inclusion of skill sets. Current coverage includes natural‑language processing, data extraction, and tool integration modules; completeness and update frequency depend on upstream repositories.

signals.title: bernardTavares/bevox-company-os
signals.content: Supervised agent pipeline for a one-person AI company: plans → kanban → headless Claude Code → deterministic + LLM gate → Telegram escalation. FSL-1.1-MIT.
signals.score_reason: high-value open-source ecosystem signal; agentic AI relevance; large language model relevance. Final score: 68. Freshness: source age 0d.
signals.brief_en: Brief: bernardTavares/bevox-company-os – A supervised agent pipeline designed for a solo AI venture. Workflow: strategic plans feed a Kanban board, which triggers headless Claude code execution. Outputs pass through a deterministic filter and an LLM gate before optional escalation to Telegram for human review. Licensed under FSL‑1.1‑MIT. The architecture aims to streamline development while maintaining oversight, but actual performance and scalability remain unverified.

signals.content: ⚡️🇮🇷🇪🇺 — Iranian MP and National Security Committee member Ahmad Bakhshayesh Ardestani threatened missile strikes on any European base used by the US against Iran, explicitly naming Italy and Germany, and warned that countries enabling US attacks would face retaliation against their “material and non-material assets”; he said Iran had refrained from such action in the previous two wars. Fellow committee member Fada Hossein Maleki said Tehran had prepared a new conflict scenario intended to surprise the US and Europe. — Euronews ➡️ Kayhan, published under the supervision of a representative of Ayatollah Mojtaba Khamenei, said Iran’s potential targets could extend beyond US bases in the Middle East to “the heart of Europe,” citing an order it attributed to Khamenei for a military response “without geographical limits.” ➡️ Fars separately reported that Iran warned Germany its military assets across the region would be “legitimate defensive targets” if Berlin entered open military confrontation with Iran. Tehran had also summoned Germany’s ambassador in recent weeks over Berlin’s support for Israel.
